evidence.reason: mergeHeadEvidence now reads each published commit's parent list with `rev-list --parents -n 1` and refuses any commit with more than one parent before `diff-tree`, so a merge commit in input.commits can no longer silently hide the paths it repaired (test added in test/ops/crq/mergeHeadEvidence.test.ts).
